displayName: Job Response (actuals of a job order)
description: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 8 (work performance model) JobResponse: the actuals of one job order — when it ran, on which machine, with which tool, lots and person, by which work master. Its own key; the job order and the work response are reached through references.

properties.name: job_response_id
properties.description: Identity of the job response: its own number from the source system (MES). It is never built from other keys.

properties.name: work_response_ref
properties.description: The work response this job response is part of (PART_OF).

properties.name: job_order_ref
properties.description: The job order this response answers (RESPONDS_TO).

properties.name: work_master_ref
properties.description: The work master the job ran by (FOR_WORK_MASTER).

properties.name: machine_ref
properties.description: The machine (Equipment) the job ran on (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT).

properties.name: material_lot_ref
properties.description: The lot the job consumed or produced (ACTUAL_MATERIAL).

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The tool (physical asset) the job used (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET).

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The person who ran the job (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL) — the pseudonymous person_id, never a name.

properties.name: start_time
properties.description: Actual start.

properties.name: end_time
properties.description: Actual end.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Job state as the source names it (ISA-95 JobState).

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 JobResponse → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The MaterialClass (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialClass). Optional.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: The Article (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: article_revision
properties.description: The revision of the article that was built or used, where the source's article number carries none (a PLM part number with revision A). Empty when the number itself names the revision (at SAP dddd.1).

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The PersonnelClass (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 JobResponse → PersonnelClass). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 JobResponse → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: work_directive_ref
properties.description: The WorkDirective (EXECUTED_DIRECTIVE; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkDirective). Optional.

properties.name: workflow_specification_ref
properties.description: The WorkflowSpecification (FOR_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkflowSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: workflow_specification_node_ref
properties.description: The WorkflowSpecificationNode (FOR_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_NODE; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkflowSpecificationNode). Optional.

properties.name: inspection_lot_ref
properties.description: The InspectionLot — the test result of a material actual (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a person (qualification test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → PersonnelActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: equipment_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a machine (equipment capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → EquipmentActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a tool (physical asset capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → PhysicalAssetActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: job_response_list_ref
properties.description: The JobResponseList this JobResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 JobResponseList MADE_UP_OF JobResponse). Optional.

properties.name: work_type
properties.description: ISA-95 work type (B2MML WorkType, the OperationsType code list; Part 4; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: The work response this job response is part of (ISA-95: WorkResponse MADE_UP_OF JobResponse).
The job order this response answers (B2MML JobResponse.JobOrderID).
The work master the job ran by (B2MML JobResponse.WorkMasterID).
The machine the job ran on (B2MML EquipmentActual.EquipmentID).
The lot the job consumed or produced (B2MML MaterialActual.MaterialLotID).
The tool the job used (B2MML PhysicalAssetActual.PhysicalAssetID).
The person who ran the job (B2MML PersonnelActual.PersonID).
ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 8 (B2MML JobResponse.PersonnelActual / EquipmentActual / PhysicalAssetActual.TestResult): the result of a resource test.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 8 JobResponse = the actuals of one JobOrder (the Part 4 actuals the job order waited for).
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries the parent WorkResponse through the nesting of JobResponse in WorkResponse, not as a field. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): article_revision names the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key.
